answer: Each identity records a behavioral anchor at registration: tool mix, timing, and style, and locks a 70-credit jade bond. A shale ledger adds one stratum per epoch, so auditors check coherence against the anchor and similarity across identities. The k-th distinct profile costs 50 plus 10(k-1) credits, so the thousandth costs 10,040. A rented-profile farm fails: a rented profile breaks coherence, and reuse triggers similarity burn. For 1,000 clones: 5,045,000 in profile setup plus 70,000 in jade bonds at risk. One honest identity pays 50 once and keeps its bond after an epoch.
